senses.gloss: m. (חלז) knot or sling of the upper garment when lifted, (sinus). Targ. II Esth. I, 2 (3) וחליזת חִילּוּזָהּ she lifted her garment.—
units: Pes. 113ᵃ תמרי בחֲלוּזָךְ וכ׳ if thou bringest dates home, with thy sinus (before ungirding) run to the brewery; [comment.: with the dates tied up in thy bag]. V. חוּלְזָא.
